For a particle at position $\mathbf{r}$ with momentum $\mathbf{p}$ the orbital angular momentum is
the cross product $\mathbf{r}\times\mathbf{p}$; reversing the order of the factors flips its sign,
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{r}\times\mathbf{p} = -\,\mathbf{p}\times\mathbf{r} .
\label{eq:L}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
